20.en: "This is HIS IMPERIUM, and shall continue AS HE MANDATED! For a mere mortal to deign to change even the most minute cog of its workings is blasphemous arrogance. This sector is a testament to His divine will, and I am an arbiter of His merciless judgement"

38.en: The God-Emperor’s divine plan is unfolding as it should.

46.en: The status quo within the Imperium must be maintained at all costs.

76.en: Strike down emergent heresy within the Adeptus Terra, especially Radical Inquisitors. Cooperate and promote unity with all factions of the Adeptus Terra, sharing information with them wherever necessary. Quell any interfactional infighting that threatens to destabilise the Imperium.

82.en: For millennia, the Emperor has led His Imperium through the darkness of a hostile galaxy, miraculously conducting a plan beyond mortal comprehension to ensure the domination of Mankind. This is the core belief of the Amalathian philosophy, swearing absolute fealty to the Emperor and believing with unquestioning absolutism that every machination of His bellicose realm is operating strictly as intended.

86.en: The monolithic Amalath, the largest mountain of the world Gathalamor in Segmentum Solar, can be considered the spiritual genesis of this Puritan philosophy and the Macharian Crusade. The Conclave held there at the dawn of the 41st millennium saw mighty exemplars of the Imperium redouble their oathbound dedication to the Master of Mankind, fervent in believing that all past obstacles were merely preparations for what was to come.

90.en: For Amalathians, change heralds disaster, and any misguided attempt to ‘improve’ the labyrinthine workings of the Imperium must be prevented. Any action outside of His will could have dire, unforeseen consequences. Radical philosophies of any kind are akin to heresy to the Puritan Amalathians, but their hard line nature can appear Radical to their peers.

94.en: Amalathians in the Macharian Sector often operate secretly and in isolation, allowing other Imperial factions to perform their crucial work and prioritising any threats that might destabilise existing power structures. Forbidden knowledge must remain proscribed, and the Inquisition must remain an unseen force, protecting the Imperium from infestations by xenos beyond His realm and daemons beyond reality, preserving all institutions from the heresy of change.

110.en: They wield a holier-than-thou attitude, holding their moral superiority over the heads of heretics like a guillotine. Yet for those who put the needs of the Imperium before their lives, Amalathians hold a quiet admiration and respect.

118.en: To protect the status quo, they must be experts in it; they should know the internal machinations and bureaucracies of the Imperium inside out.

126.en: They should be critical of any purported change or deviation from the Lex Imperialis or Imperial Creed and readily punish those who strive to alter the Imperium’s laws or institutions.

140.en: The party’s Patron is investigating House Alencar on planet Paleo. The noble house has introduced changes to improve living conditions for their workforce at the cost of their economic output; some of these unsanctioned reforms are already gaining headway within other local houses. The party must uncover what heresy has caused this shift in the noble house’s ideals.

148.en: Osmodia Beta’s planetary tithe has come to a standstill. The local @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus} believe their forge world should be re-tooled to produce Imperial Titans, but the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} has outright blocked their proposal, knowing that the billions of las packs the planet typically produces are crucial to defending the sector. The stalemate is causing the planet’s workers to suffer; riots are sure to occur if left unresolved.
